scope: Source checkout; synthetic standard-library MMTT tasks and patched root tooling. No bundled native runtime.
policy: In a publication snapshot, task-directed installation refuses every project outside the reviewed allowlist before launching any installer. Historical locks remain unchanged, not patched or dismissed. Direct manual uv commands are outside this supported route.
